basics.name: Haolin (Jayden) Xie
basics.label: Full-Stack & Security Engineer
basics.summary: Computer Science student at UC San Diego and full-stack / security engineer. I build secure web applications, developer tools, and AI-powered products, with hands-on experience in application security, backend development, and applied machine learning.

work.name: VisionX LLC
work.summary: Backend security and application-layer monitoring for a health application handling sensitive health data.
highlights: Strengthened backend security by identifying and remediating 26 known dependency vulnerabilities, upgrading 8 critical Python dependencies including Django and Pillow, and adding regression tests for image upload functionality.

Restored CI testing gates across the pull-request workflow and integrated pip-audit and Dependabot for automated dependency security scanning, keeping new vulnerabilities monitored without disrupting the deployment pipeline.

Designed and implemented an extensible application-layer security monitoring framework from scratch, using a pluggable detector architecture with centralized SecurityEvent/Signal models and fail-open execution so monitoring failures never affect application availability.

Developed detectors for failed logins, unauthorized access attempts, and unauthorized sensitive-data access, with PHI-safe event logging restricted to metadata; expanded the test suite from 211 to 290 passing tests with measured monitoring overhead of ~0.0046 ms/request.

work.name: San Francisco State University
highlights: Guided 200+ students in solving Java programming problems, covering conditionals, control flow, and object-oriented design.
Debugged and resolved students' coding issues one-on-one, reinforcing concepts in exception handling, data structures, and object-oriented programming.

work.name: SoftCom Lab — Computer Science Department, Cal Poly Pomona
highlights: Researched and implemented AI/ML algorithms for mobile app video content extraction, improving extraction accuracy through model evaluation and optimization.
Integrated trained AI models with a mobile application backend and deployed the system to a cloud environment, enabling real-time inference for end users.

projects.name: CLI Password Manager
projects.summary: A secure command-line credential manager with role-based access control and AES-256 encryption.
highlights: Built a command-line credential manager with admin/guest role-based access control, encrypting all stored passwords using AES-256-CBC with keys managed via environment variables.

Implemented bcrypt-hashed admin authentication and an interactive CLI with Inquirer.js supporting full CRUD operations on a MySQL-backed credential vault; applied a modular architecture with .env configuration and clean Git practices.

projects.name: RAG Chatbot
projects.summary: A full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation web app that answers questions over uploaded PDFs.
highlights: Built a full-stack RAG web application that answers questions over uploaded PDFs using the OpenAI API for response generation and Transformers.js for local document embedding and semantic search.
Implemented secure user authentication with JWT tokens and bcrypt-hashed passwords stored in MySQL, with connection pooling and SQL injection protection.
Developed backend routes for file uploads, PDF extraction, and persistent vector stores for retrieval over embedded chunks.

projects.name: Rz VideoCut
projects.summary: An AI-powered cross-platform video editing app that automates face-tracking and cropping. U.S. patent granted.
highlights: Developed an AI-powered video editing app automating face-tracking and cropping using MediaPipe Face Detection with six landmarks and multi-face support; built cross-platform in Dart with custom UX/UI and launched on the App Store and Google Play.
Co-authored and presented "An Intelligent Video Editing Automate Framework using AI and Computer Vision" at ITCSE 2022.
Obtained a U.S. Patent from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), Jul. 2022.
